command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=3e0d073b7b6a4ba41117ffd8ad8c06dd0da8e62d
REMOTE=https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git
STERN="$HOME/.claude/star/stern.py"
DEST="$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts"
VOICE=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service
CLIENT=frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service
status_json="$(python3 "$STERN" gespraech-status)"
aktiv="$(printf '%s' "$status_json" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(str(bool(json.load(sys.stdin).get("aktiv"))).lower())')"
[ "$aktiv" = false ] || { echo 'REFUSED: voice active' >&2; exit 20; }
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-main-sync.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git -C "$tmp" init -q
git -C "$tmp" remote add origin "$REMOTE"
git -C "$tmp" fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$EXPECTED"
git -C "$tmp" checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
[ "$(git -C "$tmp" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED" ] || exit 21
python3 "$tmp/tests/test_omega_organ_activity.py"
python3 "$tmp/tests/test_omega_arm_bus.py"
python3 "$tmp/tests/test_voice777_multiarm_integration.py"
python3 "$tmp/tests/test_voice777_installer_convergence.py"
echo SOURCE_TESTS_PASS=1
bash "$tmp/scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh"
files='omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice777_local_audio_arm.py voice777_omni_presence.py voice777_pocket_renderer.py voice_full_runtime.py frank_terminal.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py'
for f in $files; do cmp -s "$tmp/scripts/$f" "$DEST/$f" || { echo "FAIL mismatch $f" >&2; exit 22; }; done
echo INSTALL_READBACK_PASS=1
status_json="$(python3 "$STERN" gespraech-status)"; aktiv="$(printf '%s' "$status_json" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(str(bool(json.load(sys.stdin).get("aktiv"))).lower())')"; [ "$aktiv" = false ] || { echo 'REFUSED: voice became active' >&2; exit 23; }
systemctl --user restart "$CLIENT"
systemctl --user restart "$VOICE"
for u in "$CLIENT" "$VOICE"; do for i in $(seq 1 20); do [ "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u" 2>/dev/null || true)" = active ] && break; sleep 1; done; [ "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u" 2>/dev/null || true)" = active ] || { echo "FAIL inactive $u" >&2; exit 24; }; done
cpid="$(systemctl --user show "$CLIENT" -p MainPID --value)"; vpid="$(systemctl --user show "$VOICE" -p MainPID --value)"
ccmd="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$cpid/cmdline")"; vcmd="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$vpid/cmdline")"
case "$ccmd" in *voice_host_777_live_client.py*) ;; *) exit 25;; esac
case "$vcmd" in *voice_777_runtime.py*) ;; *) exit 26;; esac
printf 'CLIENT_PID=%s\nVOICE_PID=%s\nCLIENT_CMD=%s\nVOICE_CMD=%s\n' "$cpid" "$vpid" "$ccmd" "$vcmd"
echo OMEGA_INSTALLED_SOURCE_SHA256_OMEGA_ORGAN_ACTIVITY=$(sha256sum "$DEST/omega_organ_activity.py" | awk '{print $1}')
systemctl --user show "$CLIENT" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p NRestarts --no-pager
systemctl --user show "$VOICE" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p NRestarts --no-pager
python3 "$STERN" gespraech-status
echo OMEGA_LIVE_MAIN_COMMIT=$EXPECTED
echo OMEGA_LIVE_MAIN_SYNC_PASS=1
